verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              विवस्वान् कश्यपाज्जज्ञे दाक्षायण्यामरिन्दम। तस्य भार्याभवत्संज्ञा त्वाष्ट्री देवी विवस्वतः॥१॥
verses.bhavadeepa: यत्र वृष्णिवंशे॥४५॥

verses.sanskrit: सुरेणुरिति विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु भामिनी। सा वै भार्या भगवतो मार्तण्डस्य महात्मनः॥२॥
verses.english: And another son of Sungod, the brother of manu, is shaniH-cara, who got planethood and worshipped by one and all...
verses.bhavadeepa: विवेस्वतोऽथ संज्ञायाः श्राद्धदेवमनोर्भवः। अश्विनोश्चापि चक्रस्य जनुर्नवम ईर्यते॥१॥ वैवस्वतस्य मनोः विसर्गं कीर्तयिष्यामीत्युक्तं तदेवाह- विवस्वानित्यादिना। दाक्षायण्यां दक्षकन्यायाम् अदित्यां त्वाष्ट्री त्वष्टुः पुत्री॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: भर्तृरूपेण नातुष्यद्रूपयौवनशालिनी। संज्ञाना स्त्री सुतपसा दीप्तेनेह समन्विता॥३॥
verses.english: Presently the form of Sungod is uniform, lengthwise and breadthwise, by which flatness he is termed as विभावसु...
verses.bhavadeepa: सुरेणुरिति संज्ञाया एव नामान्तरम्। भामिनी कोपना। भाविनीति पाठे शुद्धचित्तेति॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यस्य हि तद्रूपं मण्डलस्य सुतेजसा। गात्रेषु परिदग्धं वै नातिकान्तमिवाभवत्॥४॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the ninth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the emergence of vaivasvata-manu, the son of Sungod .
verses.bhavadeepa: दीप्तेन अत्युष्णेन भर्तृरूपेण॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: न खल्वयं मृतोऽण्डस्थ इति स्नेहादभाषत। अज्ञानात् कश्यपस्तस्मान्मार्तण्ड इति चोच्यते॥५॥
verses.english: He who listens or memorises this episode narrating the emergence of these gods, his fear in calamity will e removed and he achieves great renown.
verses.bhavadeepa: तद्रूपं तस्याः संज्ञायाः रूपं मण्डलस्थस्य तेजसा गात्रेषु दग्धम्॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: तेजस्त्वभ्यधिकं तात नित्यमेव विवस्वतः। येनातितापयामास त्रीँल्लोकान्कश्यपात्मजः॥६॥
verses.english: With the granules erupted while toning down the radiance of Sungod on a lathe, tvaSTha, alias vishva-karma, prepared a disc, called viShNu-cakram, and gave it to shriihari, with an intention that his disc would eradicate all demons in battles...
verses.bhavadeepa: दाहे हेतुमाह- न खल्विति द्वाभ्याम्। भिक्षार्थम् आगतेन बुधेन गर्भगौरवाच्छीघ्रं मिक्षामप्रयच्छती अदितिः शप्ता तव गर्भोऽयं म्रियतामिति। तच्छ्रुत्वा व्याकुलामदितिं प्रति भार्यास्नेहात् कश्यपः स्वसामर्थ्यात् बुधशापं निवार्य अभाषत। अयं खलु इति निश्चयेन न मृतः अपि तु अण्डस्थ एवास्तीति तस्माददितेरज्ञानात् मम अण्डं मृतमित्येवंरूपात् विपरीतज्ञानात् अयं मार्तण्ड इत्युच्यते। मृतम् अण्डमस्येति मृताण्डं तस्माज्जातो मार्तण्डः शकन्ध्वादित्वात्पररूपम्॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: त्रीण्यपत्यानि कौरव्य संज्ञायां तपतां वरः। आदित्यो जनयामास कन्यां द्वौ च प्रजापती॥७॥
verses.english: Lady saMj~na, somehow tolerating the radiation of that supreme scorcher, namely Aditya, the Sun, gave rise to three of his children, one girl and two prajApati-s...
verses.bhavadeepa: तेज इति। स एवं कश्यपमाहात्म्याज्जीवितोऽतितेजस्वी संज्ञाम् अतिसान्निध्यादत्यन्तं तापयामासेति भावः॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: मनुर्वैवस्वतः पूर्वं श्राद्धदेवः प्रजापतिः। यमश्च यमुना चैव यमजौ सम्बभूवतुः॥८॥
verses.english: Out of those two prajApati-s one is वैवस्वत prajApati, because he is the son of विवस्वान्, namely the Sun himself while the other is श्राद्ध-देव, presiding deity of obsequial oblations, namely यम, or also called शमन, the eternal silencer and the girl is a twin sister of yama, named as lady यमुन॥।

verses.sanskrit: सा विवर्णं तु तद्रूपं दृष्ट्वा संज्ञा विवस्वतः। असहन्ती च स्वां छायां सवर्णां निर्ममे ततः॥९॥
verses.english: Unable to further tolerate the irradiative aspect of Sun, which can be endured only through a hardship, then saMj~na created a form from out of her own shade, calling her lady cछाय...
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रजापतीनाह- मनुरिति। मनुः श्राद्धदेवाख्यो यमश्च यमजौ यमलौ॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: मायामयी तु सा संज्ञा तस्याश्छाया समुत्थिता। प्राञ्जलिः प्रणता भूत्वा छाया संज्ञां नरेश्वर॥१०॥
verses.english: Because of that flatness, vivasvAn prajApati, namely Sungod, much appreciated the suggestion of tvaSTha, and permitted him to reshape his form, in order to get a pleasant form...
verses.bhavadeepa: विवर्णं विषमवर्णं दुःसहकारकं स्वां छायां स्वस्य प्रतिमां सवर्णां समानरूपाम्॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: उवाच किं मया कार्यं कथयस्व शुचिस्मिते। स्थितास्मि तव निर्देशे शाधि मां वरवर्णिनि॥११॥
verses.english: And oh, king, that lady cChAya, a completely artificial entity, emerged from out of the shade of lady saMj~na, stood before lady saMj~na with folded palms...
verses.bhavadeepa: छायासंज्ञामुवाचेति सम्बन्धः॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit:
संज्ञोवाच।
              अहं यास्यामि भद्रं ते स्वमेव भवनं पितुः। त्वयेह भवने मह्यं वस्तव्यं निर्विकारया॥१२॥
verses.english: "Oh, lady with beautiful smile, tell me what I have to do...oh, lady with best complexion, here I am in your service...order me..." So said lady cChAya to saMj~na...
verses.bhavadeepa: शाधि आज्ञापय॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: इमौ च बालकौ मह्यं कन्या चेयं सुमध्यमा। सम्भाव्यास्ते न चाख्येयमिदं भगवते क्वचित्॥१३॥
verses.english: Then saMj~na replied her saying, "I am going away to my father's house...in my place, you shall stay here, without becoming a rara avis - निर्-वि-कारया - these two are my sons, and this slender-waisted girl is my daughter, whom you have take under your care like me...and I believe, you won't reveal this arrangement to lord Sun, at anytime...
verses.bhavadeepa: मह्यं मम॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit:
छायोवाच।
              आ कचग्रहणाद्देवि आ शापान्नैव कर्हिचित्। आख्यास्यामि मतं तुभ्यं गच्छ देवि यथासुखम्॥१४॥
verses.english: "I will never, never reveal this arrangement, except in the case of someone catching me by my knead-hair, or someone hurling a curse at me...as such, oh. lady, you may go as you please and feel comfortable..." So said lady cChAya to lady saMj~na.
verses.bhavadeepa: ते त्वया इदं मत्कृत्यं भगवते सूर्याय॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              समादिश्य सवर्णां तां तथेत्युक्त्वा च सा तया। त्वष्टुः समीपमगमद्व्रीडितेव तपस्विनी॥१५॥
verses.english: Instructing lady cChAya about dos and don'ts of household affairs, lady saMj~na reached her father's house, namely the house of tvaShTa, with a diffidence to leave her own house...
verses.bhavadeepa: तुभ्यं तव॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: पितुः समीपगा सा तु पित्रा निर्भर्त्सिता तदा। भर्तुः समीपं गच्छेति नियुक्ता च पुनः पुनः॥१६॥
verses.english: And when she arrived in the presence of her father, namely tvaShTa, or vishva-karma, he spewed ire on her and demanded repeatedly that she should at once go to her husband...
verses.bhavadeepa: व्रीडितेव लज्जितेव यतस्तपस्विनी आलोचनवती अनाकारिताया मम इहागमनं भर्तुस्त्यागश्चाकीर्तिकर इत्याशयः॥१५॥

verses.sanskrit: अगच्छद्वडवा भूत्वाऽऽच्छाद्य रूपमनिन्दिता। कुरूनथोत्तरान् गत्वा तृणान्येव चचार ह॥१७॥
verses.english: And that unblemished lady saMj~na came out of her father's house also. Then, on donning a mare's form, ion which form she is called वडव, or बडब, she roamed in the places of Northern kuru kingdom, surviving on grass-blades...

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयायां तु संज्ञायां संज्ञेयमिति चिन्तयन्। आदित्यो जनयामास पुत्रमात्मसमं तदा॥१८॥
verses.english: Believing the replica of saMj~na as saMj~na herself, the Sun lived with her, begetting two selfsame sons through her...
verses.bhavadeepa: आच्छाद्य गोपयित्वा॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वजस्य मनोस्तात सदृशोऽयमिति प्रभुः। सवर्णत्वान्मनोर्भूयः सार्वर्ण इति चोक्तवान्॥१९॥
verses.english: From that seed of Sungod, which baDaba alias saMj~na sneezed off from her nose, there arose two gods, namely अश्विनि-कुमर-s. These are the twin gods who are the best among physicians. One is called न-असत्य, and the other दस्र...

verses.sanskrit: मनुरेवाभवन्नाम्ना सावर्ण इति चोच्यते। द्वितीयो यः सुतस्तस्याः स विज्ञेयः शनैश्चरः॥२०॥
verses.english: Lady cChAya, the double of saMj~na, showed more affinity with her own children, and despised the elder children of her co-wife, with a sublunary complex...
verses.bhavadeepa: पूर्वस्य भ्रातुः समानवर्णत्वादयं सावर्ण इत्युक्तो न तु सवर्णाया अपत्यत्वादित्यर्थः॥१९॥

verses.sanskrit: संज्ञा तु पार्थिवी तात स्वस्य पुत्रस्य वै तदा। चकाराभ्यधिकं स्नेहं न तथा पूर्वजेषु वै॥२१॥
verses.english: Out of the two sons of real saMj~na, the elder one, namely वैवस्वत, is able to tolerate the attitude of his stepmother cChAya, but the second one, namely शमन, or यम, did not tolerate her partial attitude owing to his exasperation, childhood, and her predominance...

verses.sanskrit: मनुस्तस्या क्षमत्तत्तु यमस्तस्या न चक्षमे। तां स रोषाच्च बाल्याच्च भाविनोऽर्थस्य वै बलात्। यदा सन्तर्ज्जयामास संज्ञां वैवस्वतो यमः॥२२॥
verses.english: And when he used to threaten her repeatedly, showing his foot at her as if to punt her...then, oh, king, lady cChAya coming into a fit of fury cursed yama saying. "let your foot break loose and fall down on earth..." yama is much perturbed by this curse, came to his father, namely the Sun, and reverently reported what all has happened as he is much alarmed by her words of curse.
verses.bhavadeepa: पृथिवीति पूर्वोक्ता सुरेणुरेव संज्ञाख्या तस्या इयं प्रकृतिः पार्थिवी द्वितीया संज्ञा। अन्ये तु छायानिपातेन पृथिव्या उत्थितत्वात्पार्थिवीत्याहुः॥२१॥

verses.sanskrit: तं शशाप ततः क्रोधात्सावर्णं जननी नृप। चरणः पततामेव तवेति भृशदुःखिता॥२३॥
verses.english: Knowing the curse as an irreversible one, yama spoke to his father Sun in this way, "a mother has to acquit herself equally among all sons...such as she is, she is discarding us and caring more for her sons...I confess that I raised my foot against her, but did not kick her at all...maybe I have done it childishly or foolishly...for that it will be apt of you to excuse me...I am your son, yet my feet are going to fall off undoubtedly...there may be a good son or a bad son, but there cannot be a bad mother...oh, lord, I have been cursed and about to loose my feet...oh, lord of living creatures, show grace on me and avert the situation..."
verses.bhavadeepa: तत्तस्याः मनुः क्षमत् क्षान्तवान्। आर्षम् अडभावादि॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: यमस्तु तत्पितुः सर्वं प्राञ्जलिः प्रत्यवेदयत्। भृशं शापभयोद्विग्नः संज्ञावाक्यप्रतोदितः॥२४॥
शापोऽयं विनिवर्तेत प्रोवाच पितरं तदा। मात्रा स्नेहेन सर्वेषु वर्तितव्यं सुतेषु वै॥२५॥
verses.english: As I cannot reverse your mother's words, let worms take pieces of flesh from your feet to earth, whereby your mother's words will come true, and you too can comfortably move on your feet as usual...further, you will be saved from the effect of curse also.." So said Sungod to his son, yama.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रतोदितः व्यथितः। विरेजित इति पाठे तापितः॥२४॥

verses.sanskrit: सेयमस्मानपाहाय यवीयांसं बुभूषति। तस्यां मयोद्यतः पादो न तु देहे निपातितः॥२६॥
verses.english: Then, though Aditya, the Sungod, asked lady cChAya repeatedly, saying, "when all the children are to be treated equally, why do you show extra favour towards some only..." But she did not bother to reply him, every time she used to change the orientation of that topic with a derisive smile...

verses.sanskrit: बाल्याद्वा यदि वा मोहात्तद्भवान्क्षन्तुमर्हति। यस्मात्ते पूजनीयाहं लङ्घितास्मि त्वया सुत॥२७॥
verses.english: Though he controlled himself for a long time, and much time has lapsed between his questioning and her derisive smiles, he did not find way out, or what has actually happened between mother and children is unknown to him. This roused a fit of anger in Sungod on certain occassion, and he caught hold of her hair-bun in order to curse her to elimination...
verses.bhavadeepa: बुभूषति भूषयितुमिच्छति॥२६॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तवैष चरणः पतिष्यति न संशयः। अपत्यं दुरपत्यं स्यान्नाम्बा कुजननी भवेत्॥२८॥
verses.english: When her hair is caught, cChAya had to reveal the secret pact between her and saMj~na, and she revealed everything as has happened. Sungod is further infuriated to listen all that and immediately came to tvaShTa, or vishva-karma, the father of saMj~na, in search of his wife, namely real saMj~na. On seeing him, tvaShTa revered his son-in-law Sungod according to custom, and pacified him who is hell-bent on burning everything down, as his wife is not in his proximity.

verses.sanskrit: शप्तोऽहमस्मि लोकेश जनन्या तपतां वर। तव प्रसादाच्चरणो न पतेन्मम गोपते॥२९॥
verses.english: "Your form possessed with too much of radiance is not that pleasant...unable to tolerate such a form of yours, saMj~na is wandering on lawns...you can see your dear wife today itself, who is highly virtuous, always in an ascetic's mood, and who is wandering in the form of a mare...

verses.sanskrit:
विवस्वानुवाच।
              असंशयं पुत्र महद्भविष्यत्यत्र कारणम्। येन त्वामाविशत् क्रोधो धर्मज्ञं सत्यवादिनम्॥३०॥
verses.english: विवस्वान्, namely the Sun, emerged from lady अदितिand kashyapa prajApati, where lady aditi is the daughter of daksha, hence called dAkshAyiNi... And the wife of vivasAn, namely Sungod, is lady संज्ञ,the daughter of त्वाSटृ prajApati ...

verses.sanskrit: न शक्यमन्यथा कर्तुं मया मातुर्वचस्तव। कृमयो मांसमादाय यास्यन्ति धरणीतलम्॥३१॥
verses.english: If my advise of toning down your radiant form is acceptable to you, she obliges you, and I can finetune your radiance now itself to make it tolerably pleasant..." So said tvaSTha to Sungod.

verses.sanskrit: तव पादान्महाप्राज्ञ ततस्त्वं प्राप्स्यसे सुखम्। कृतमेवं वचस्तथ्यं मातुस्तव भविष्यति॥३२॥
verses.english: Presently the form of Sungod is uniform, lengthwise and breadthwise, by which flatness he is termed as विभावसु...

verses.sanskrit: शापस्य परिहारेण त्वं च त्रातो भविष्यसि। आदित्योऽथाब्रवीत् संज्ञां किमर्थं तनयेषु वै॥३३॥
verses.english: Because of that flatness, vivasvAn prajApati, namely Sungod, much appreciated the suggestion of tvaSTha, and permitted him to reshape his form, in order to get a pleasant form...

verses.sanskrit: तुल्येष्वभ्यधिकः स्नेहः क्रियतेऽति पुनः पुनः। सा तत् परिहरन्ती तु नाचचक्षे विवस्वते॥३४॥
verses.english: Then tvaSTha neared Sungod, placed him on a grindstone, and started to grind the radiance.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं सुसमाधाय योगात्तथ्यमपश्यत। तां शप्तुकामो भगवान्नाशाय कुरुनन्दन॥३५॥
verses.english: Then, on dulling the form and reducing the radiance, the Sungod's form became brightest from just bright, and it has become a pleasure to have a look at it...
verses.bhavadeepa: अभ्यधिकः स्नेहः कनीयसि। तत्संज्ञाकृत्यं परिहरन्ती गूहमाना॥३४॥

verses.sanskrit: मूर्धजेषु च जग्राह समयेऽतिगतेऽपि च। सा तत्सर्वं यथावृत्तमाचचक्षे विवस्वते॥३६॥
verses.bhavadeepa: सुसमाधाय सुस्थिरं कृत्वा योगात् ध्यानात्॥३५॥

verses.sanskrit: विवस्वानथ तच्छ्रुत्वा क्रुद्धस्त्वष्टारमभ्यगात्। त्वष्टा तु तं यथान्यायमर्चयित्वा विभावसुम्। निर्दग्धुकामं रोषेण सान्त्वयामास वै तदा॥३७॥
verses.english: These are the twelve AdityA-s emerged from the face of Sungod while it is being abraded...they are: धात, अर्यमा, मित्र, वरुण, अम्श, भग, इन्द्र, विवस्वान्, पूष; and the tenth one is पर्जन्य; then त्वष्ट has emerged, and then, last but not the least, विष्णु has also emerged...
verses.bhavadeepa: समये आकेशग्रहणात् आशापाच्च नैतत्प्रकाशयिष्यामीति नियमे अतिगते अतिक्रान्ते सति॥३६॥

verses.sanskrit:
त्वष्टोवाच।
              तवातितेजसाविष्टमिदं रूपं न शोभते। असहन्ती च तत्संज्ञा वने चरति शाड्वले॥३८॥
verses.english: And the Sungod felt highly rejoiced to see the twelve Aditya-s emerging from out of his own body who are bedecked with fragrances, flowers and highly glittering crowns...

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टा हि तां भवानद्य स्वां भार्यां शुभचारिणीम्। नित्यं तपस्यभिरतां वडवारूपधारिणीम्॥३९॥
verses.english: tvaSTha too is rejoiced and worshipped those twelve Aditya-s in his turn, and then spoke to Sungod in this way...
verses.bhavadeepa: शाड्वले हरिततृणे॥३८॥

verses.sanskrit: पर्णाहारां कृशां दीनां जटिलां ब्रह्मचारिणीम्। हस्तिहस्तपरिक्लिष्टां व्याकुलां पद्मिनीमिव। श्लाघ्यां योगबलोपेतां योगमास्थाय गोपते॥४०॥
verses.english: That celibate lady is withered, pitiable, and wilted like a lotus-lake splurged by an elephant's trunk, and yet, oh, lord of rays, Sungod, subsisting on grassblades, she that praiseworthy lady is living on by means of her yogic power...
verses.bhavadeepa: भवान् द्रष्टा द्रक्ष्यति॥३९॥

verses.sanskrit: अनुकूलं तु देवेश यदि स्यान्मम तन्मतम्। रूपं निर्वर्तयाम्यद्य तव कान्तमरिन्दम॥४१॥
verses.english: Assuming the form of a horse Sungod could find his wife by the dint of his yogic power, and they moved together without being assailed by all beings, and in a self-controlled manner. Because saMj~na is moving in the form of a mare, what for she should fear in the least!!!
verses.bhavadeepa: हस्तिहस्तेन गजगुण्डादण्डेन परिक्लिष्टां पद्मिनीमिव॥४०॥

verses.sanskrit: रूपं विवस्वतश्चासीत्तिर्यगूर्ध्वसमं तु वै। तेनासौ सम्भृतो देवरूपेण तु विभावसुः॥४२॥
verses.english: Sungod in the form of a horse neared saMj~na from font end for foreplay, but her resistant behaviour to participate in mating, with a little doubt that he is not her male, made the seed of Sungod fall on her nostrils, which she snuffled off.
verses.bhavadeepa: तत् मदन्तःकरणस्थं मतम् अद्य तव रूपं कान्तं मनोहरं निर्वर्तयामि सम्पादयामीति॥४१॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्त्वष्टुः स वै वाक्यं बहु मेने प्रजापतिः। समनुज्ञातवांश्चैव त्वष्टारं रूपसिद्धये॥४३॥
verses.english: From that seed of Sungod, which baDaba alias saMj~na sneezed off from her nose, there arose two gods, namely अश्विनि-कुमर-s. These are the twin gods who are the best among physicians. One is called न-असत्य, and the other दस्र...
verses.bhavadeepa: तेन पूर्वेण रूपेण सम्मृतः सम्पन्नः॥४२॥

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽभ्युपगमात्त्वष्टा मार्तण्डस्य विवस्वतः। भ्रमिमारोप्य तत्तेजः शातयामास भारत॥४४॥
verses.english: Thus, oh, janamejaya, these twins are the children of eight prajApati, namely mArtaNDa, the Sungod, as he begot them through saMj~na, alias baDava...and bhAskara beheld them by virtue of selfsame form and radiance in them...and finding her husband again at her side, lady saMj~na is also rejoiced...

verses.sanskrit: ततो निर्भासितं रूपं तेजसा संहृतेन वै। कान्तात्कान्ततरं द्रष्टुमधिकं शुशुभे तदा॥४५॥
verses.english: But yama is highly discomposed for his own act of showing foot to his stepmother, whereby she had to curse him...yet he is given the authority on manes, and the rulership of mortals, which he took upon himself and discharged his duties very efficiently...because he rightly administers rightness, he is called धर्म-राज...
verses.bhavadeepa: भ्रमिं भ्रामणयन्त्रम् आरोप्य रूपं शातयामास तनूकृतवान् घृष्टवानित्यर्थः॥४४॥

verses.sanskrit: मुखे निर्वर्तितं रूपं तस्य देवस्य गोपतेः। ततः प्रभृति देवस्य मुखमासीत्तु लोहितम्। मुखरागं तु यत्पूर्वं मार्तण्डस्य मुखच्युतम्॥४६॥
verses.english: When the mien of that lord of rays is thus refined, from then on it assumed a hue of ochry-red, अरुण राग, and while refining him on the lathe, there arose the following entities from the offscrourings of his face...
verses.bhavadeepa: निर्भासितं प्रकटीकृतम्। असंहतेन पृथक्कृतेन तेजसा हेतुना संहृतेनेति स्पष्टार्थः॥४५॥

verses.sanskrit: आदित्या द्वादशैवेह सम्भूता मुखसम्भवाः। धातार्यमा च मित्रश्च वरुणोंशो भगस्तथा॥४७॥
verses.english: His brother shanaiH-cara has become a planet, Saturn...and the twins nAsatya and drasa have become physicians of gods...and even if they are the physicians of gods in remote heaven, they accord health and peace to anyone who venerates them...
verses.bhavadeepa: निर्वर्तितं भ्रामणयोगान्निकषणेन सम्पादितम्॥४६॥

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रो विवस्वान् पूषा च पर्जन्यो दशमस्तथा। ततस्त्वष्टा ततो विष्णुरजघन्यो जघन्यजः॥४८॥
verses.english: With the granules erupted while toning down the radiance of Sungod on a lathe, tvaSTha, alias vishva-karma, prepared a disc, called viShNu-cakram, and gave it to shriihari, with an intention that his disc would eradicate all demons in battles...

verses.sanskrit: हर्षं लेभे ततो देवो दृष्ट्वाऽऽदित्यान् स्वदेहजान्। गन्धैः पुष्पैरलङ्कारैर्भास्वता मुकुटेन च॥४९॥
verses.english: And the Sungod felt highly rejoiced to see the twelve Aditya-s emerging from out of his own body who are bedecked with fragrances, flowers and highly glittering crowns...

verses.sanskrit: एवं सम्पूजयामास त्वष्टा वाक्यमुवाच ह। गच्छ देव निजां भार्यां कुरूंश्चरति सोत्तरान्॥५०॥
verses.english: "Oh, Sungod, now you may proceed to meet your wife who taking the form of a mare is wandering in the provinces of northern kuru..." So said tvaSTha to Sungod.

verses.sanskrit: वडवारूपमास्थाय वने चरति शाड्वले। स तथा रूपमास्थाय स्वभार्यारूपलीलया॥५१॥
verses.english: And another son of Sungod, the brother of manu, is shaniH-cara, who got planethood and worshipped by one and all...

verses.sanskrit: ददर्श योगमास्थाय स्वां भार्यां वडवां ततः। अधृष्यां सर्वभूतानां तेजसा नियमेन च॥५२॥
verses.english: He who listens or memorises this episode narrating the emergence of these gods, his fear in calamity will e removed and he achieves great renown.
verses.bhavadeepa: स्वभार्यारूपलीलया भार्यायै अनुरूपा लीला अश्वरूपेण सञ्चरणम्॥५१॥

verses.sanskrit: वडवावपुषा राजंश्चरन्तीमकुतोभयाम्। सोऽश्वरूपेण भगवांस्तां मुखे समभावयत्॥५३॥
मैथुनाय विचेष्टन्ती परपुंसोपशङ्कया। सा तन्निरवमच्छुक्रं नासिकायां विवस्वतः॥५४॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the ninth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the emergence of vaivasvata-manu, the son of Sungod .
verses.bhavadeepa: समभावयत् सङ्गमकरोत्॥५३॥

verses.sanskrit: देवौ तस्यामजायेतामश्विनौ भिषजां वरौ। नासत्यश्चैव दस्रश्च स्मृतौ द्वावश्विनाविति॥५५॥
verses.bhavadeepa: विचेष्टन्ती मैथुनप्रतिकूलां चेष्टां कुर्वाणा। परपुंसोपशङ्कया शुक्रं निरवमत्॥५४॥

verses.sanskrit: मार्तण्डस्यात्मजावेतावष्टमस्य प्रजापतेः। संज्ञायां जनयामास वडवायां स भारत। तां तु रूपेण कान्तेन दर्शयामास भास्करः॥५६॥
सा च दृष्ट्वैव भर्तारं तुतोष जनमेजय। यमस्तु कर्मणा तेन भृशं पीडितमानसः॥५७॥
धर्मेण रञ्जयामास धर्मराज इव प्रजाः। स लेभे कर्मणा तेन परमेण महाद्युतिः॥५८॥
verses.english: But yama is highly discomposed for his own act of showing foot to his stepmother, whereby she had to curse him...yet he is given the authority on manes, and the rulership of mortals, which he took upon himself and discharged his duties very efficiently...because he rightly administers rightness, he is called धर्म-राज...
verses.bhavadeepa: तेन भ्रातुः मातृशापजक्लेशेन ममाप्येवं मा भूदिति धर्ममेवाश्रयदित्यर्थः॥५७॥

verses.sanskrit: पितॄणामाधिपत्यं च लोकपालत्वमेव च। मनुः प्रजापतिस्त्वासीत्सावर्णः स तपोधनः॥५९॥
भाव्यः सोऽनागते काले मनुः सावर्णिकेऽन्तरे। मेरुपृष्ठे तपो घोरमद्यापि चरति प्रभुः॥६०॥
भ्राता शनैश्चरश्चास्य ग्रहत्वमुपलब्धवान्। नासत्यौ यौ समाख्यातौ स्वर्वैद्यौ तौ बभूवतुः॥६१॥
सेवतोऽपि तथा राजन्नश्वानां शान्तिदोऽभवत्। त्वष्टा तु तेजसा तेन विष्णोश्चक्रमकल्पयत्॥६२॥
तदप्रतिहतं युद्धे दानवान्तचिकीर्षया। यवीयसी तयोर्या तु यमी कन्या यशस्विनी॥६३॥
अभवत्सा सरिछ्रेष्ठा यमुना लोकभाविनी। मनुरित्युच्यते लोके सावर्ण इति चोच्यते॥६४॥
verses.bhavadeepa: तयोर्मनुयमयोः॥६३॥

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयो यः सुतस्तस्य मनोर्भ्राता शनैश्चरः। ग्रहत्वं स च लेभे वै सर्वलोकाभिपूजितम्॥६५॥
य इदं जन्म देवानां शृणुयाद्वापि धारयेत्। आपद्भ्यः स विमुच्येत प्राप्नुयाच्च महद्यशः॥६६॥
